gap.description: Space between clustered items, as a CSS length. Defaults to `1rem`.

justify.description: How items are distributed along the row — CSS `justify-content`. Defaults to `flex-start`.

align.description: How items line up across the row — CSS `align-items`. Defaults to `center`, which is what keeps mixed-height chips and buttons on a shared centre line.

_metadata.derivedFrom: the behavior implementation — every property here is one the code actually reads
_metadata.note: Expand by hand: enums, richer descriptions and accessibility notes cannot be read from source.
